question: Which smallest combination of complete source-MLP complement blocks closes the task-pair weight union to the full rank-16 causal program?
prior_art_search: Searched circuit authorities, prior-art records, runners, dossiers, and failure records for this exact five-MLP source complement. Only the registered singleton localizer covers this object; earlier greedy studies concern different heads or interfaces.
arms: All 32 masks. A set bit installs the complete rank-16 block at that source MLP; an unset bit installs the frozen mean-plus-contrast union. Every arm is executed on both target and matched-control populations through the complete model.
selection: Eligible masks are functional and differ from full rank-16 by at most .015 in signed response and behavior for both tasks, add no control flips beyond full, have median KL at most full+.002, and have each control-task margin RMS fraction at most full+.02. Select by fewest sites, then smallest worst target gap, then integer mask.

predictions.pred_a_authority_replay_closure_finitene: All hashes and parent terminals match; mask 0 and mask 31 replay union and full; all reports are finite; observed forwards <=96.
predictions.pred_b_strict_subset_is_full_equivalent: At least one eligible mask uses at most three of five complement sites.
predictions.pred_c_frozen_greedy_finds_global_minimu: The first eligible prefix of the frozen singleton order is exactly the globally selected mask.
predictions.pred_d_all_subset_effects_are_nearly_add: For every mask and task, behavior and signed-response deviations from union plus the registered singleton increments are <=.015.
predictions.pred_e_selected_sites_are_minimal_and_se: The selected mask passes the control rules and removing any selected site makes it ineligible.

terminal_policy.non_greedy_source_complement_program: A, B, D, and E pass but C fails.
terminal_policy.conditional_source_complement_program: A and B pass but D fails.
